inputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A genuinely hand-drawn colored-pencil and light watercolor UI sprite for a cozy animal-rescue storybook mobile game. Image 1 controls canvas size and object shape ONLY. Image 2 shows the actual game yard for palette and mood ONLY; do NOT draw scenery. Fine warm gray-green pencil contours with slight human wobble and occasional double pencil strokes, visible short colored-pencil hatching, light watercolor pigment pooling on matte ivory drawing paper. Soft spring mint, warm cream and pale peach colors; restrained, cute, clean and readable at phone size. Flat graphic, absolutely no glossy gradient, no digital airbrushed glow, no 3D, no plastic bevels, no drop shadow. PURE WHITE #ffffff outside the object, clear closed silhouette for alpha extraction. No words, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Draw ONE circular cream audio slider knob, centered, occupying 76% diameter of canvas. A clean ROUND disk with thin hand-drawn sage pencil double contour, slight pencil stroke variation but truly circular silhouette. Matte ivory paper interior, small coral-pink hand-drawn pawprint at center, four round toes and one pad, colored-pencil hatching. No plastic shine, no bevel, no square base, no perspective, no shadow. A readable little hand-drawn paper token.
inputs.negative_prompt: text, words, typography, numbers, watermark, screenshot, scenery, photorealistic, 3d, glossy, plastic, bevel, smooth digital gradient, airbrush, glowing outline, heavy black outline, dark brown frame, aged yellow parchment, distressed dirty paper, ripped edges, excessive ornaments, extra objects
